query: SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',u.id,'email',u.email,'displayName',u.display_name,'status',u.status,'rolesVersion',COALESCE((SELECT max(ur.version) FROM ops.user_roles ur WHERE ur.user_id=u.id AND ur.revoked_at IS NULL),0),'version',u.version,'lastLoginAt',u.last_login_at) ORDER BY u.display_name),'[]'::jsonb) FROM ops.users u
